headline: Iran opens to a deal with US on its enriched uranium, but rules out removing it from the country
summary: Iran's foreign minister Abbas Araqchi said Iran is open to an agreement with the United States on its enriched uranium. He said the materials will not leave the country.
why: Iran's nuclear programme and sanctions status shape oil supply expectations and risk premiums in the Middle East, which matter to energy investors.
original_headline: Irán se abre a un acuerdo con EU sobre su uranio enriquecido, pero descarta sacarlo del país
